objectives.text: Validate incoming request DTOs with Bean Validation so that invalid bodies are rejected with 400 before the service runs
Handle not-found, conflict and validation failures for every controller in one @RestControllerAdvice
Return every error as an RFC 9457 ProblemDetail body with no stack trace, checked by the public tests run with mvn -q -o test
